description: Analyze the gap between the authenticated user's current skills and what their desired roles require in the live market. Pro tier. Returns matchPct (0-100), the list of skills the user already has that map to their target roles, and the list of missing skills ranked by impact (how often the skill appears in target-role postings). Use for 'what should I learn next?' or 'how close am I to senior PM roles?'. Not for simulating the payoff of skills the user might LEARN — use `skill_impact` for that.
name: skill_gap

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Gap between the user's skills and their desired roles' requirements

learnDisclosure.description: Affiliate-link disclosure text when learn links are present

matchPct.description: Share of target-role skills the user already has, 0-100

matchedSkills.description: User skills that map to their desired roles

message.description: Present (with matchPct 0) when the profile lacks skills or desired roles

missingSkills.description: Skills the desired roles require that the user lacks, most impactful first

learn.description: Learning resources for the skill, when known

primary.description: Recommended course link (provider, url, title, free, ...)

roles.description: The desired-role titles that require it

rolesNeeding.description: How many of the user's desired roles require it (impact rank)
